en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet on Feeling (Vedanāttika)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and dissociated from neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and dissociated from painful feeling, [there arises a state that is] non-demonstrable, without resistance...
A state associated with painful feeling arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of the root condition.
(Condensed. With respect to root, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
